target_pages.rule: authentic need controls total; no padding

planned_documents.structure: open case summary, non-operative charges, chronology and disclosure issue map
planned_documents.purpose: neutral orientation without sensitive detail leakage

planned_documents.structure: core served statements, exhibits, CCTV/vehicle/phone registers and defence issue matrix
MG6-series non-sensitive schedules, disclosure officer report and decision/service history
planned_documents.purpose: item-level revelation, review, decision and continuity

planned_documents.structure: sensitive schedules, intelligence provenance and controlled review log
planned_documents.purpose: sensitivity, source, relevance and access states

planned_documents.structure: defence statement, section 8/further-disclosure and third-party request/viewing records
planned_documents.purpose: defence issues, requests, response and third-party lifecycle

planned_documents.structure: PII application, open/closed materials, hearing records, rulings, redaction and gist history

planned_documents.purpose: parent/child enumeration and signature state without auto-execution

planned_documents.structure: privilege, inadvertent-disclosure, quarantine, notification, clawback and waiver log
late-disclosure, cross-matter isolation, hearing/deadline and trial-readiness records
planned_documents.purpose: change control, contamination negatives and procedural timing

boundary: Valid controlled files only. Malicious/polyglot/corrupt inputs and parser attacks remain the separate security harness.
